Install on your TV

  1. Install Downloader (by AFTVnews) from the Play Store.
  2. Open it and enter cheungeric02.github.io/lounge
  3. Select Download Lounge.
  4. When asked, allow Downloader to install apps, then tap Install.

After installing

  1. Open Lounge → Settings → Home button.
  2. Turn on Lounge home button in Accessibility so Home brings you back to Lounge.
  3. Lounge updates itself from here; no need to come back.
